title: Module 3: Multimedia Learning Principles
description: Understanding how the brain processes multimedia information through Mayer's 12 Principles. Avoiding cognitive overload when combining text, audio, and graphics.
learning_objectives: Explain why multimedia learning depends on coordinated verbal and visual processing.
Apply Mayer's principles to reduce cognitive overload in instructional media.
Diagnose when text, graphics, and narration are competing instead of reinforcing learning.
